Implementation detail for this story (the description carries the decisions).

All cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

**Hand-rolled loader sites in the engine (Context / Problem, "twelve engine modules"):** `__main__.py:116-170`, `applier.py:226-235`, `differ.py:44,84`, `fetcher.py:153`, `inbound_collection_diffs.py:60`, `inbound_fields.py:45`, `inbound_translate.py:121`, `invariants.py:68,90`, `last_pass.py:53-64`, `pass_io.py:51,69`, `binding_repository.py:298`, `outbound_pass.py:69`. Loader sites in `src` overall (`git grep -lE 'lazy_load\(|spec_from_file_location' origin/main -- src`): 47 files — 44 under `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` (every `try: from rebar_reconciler._loader import lazy_load / except ImportError:` prologue plus the hand-rolled loaders above) and 3 outside: `src/rebar/_cli/_bridge_commands.py:147-161` (`_ref_lock_module`), `src/rebar/_lib_ops.py:161-173` (`_engine_module`), `src/rebar/mcp_server.py:367-378` (`_load_engine_mode` → `rebar._engine_mode`); plus `src/rebar/_engine_support/bridge_fsck_drift.py:31-35` and `bridge_fsck_visibility.py:36-50`. In-process `sys.path.insert(engine_dir)` sites: `_cli/__init__.py:148-151`, `_commands/_repair_pause.py:39-42`, `_commands/doctor_mapping.py:43-45`, `_commands/fsck_repair.py:344-347`. `src/rebar/graph/_loader.py:3` only mentions the idiom historically (no change).

**Scripts (Approach step 6) line cites:** `scripts/check_raw_git_writes.py:143` (`_RECONCILER = Path("src/rebar/reconciler")`), `scripts/check_config_ownership.py:77-85,137`, `scripts/capture_jira_fixtures.py:157-159`, `scripts/generate_dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.py:39-43`, `scripts/jira_dc_capability_map.py:64-82`, `scripts/measure_baseline_normalization.py:67-68,129-130,222`, `scripts/measure_get_rotation_cutover.py:22-24`, `infra/scripts/comment_echo_reclaim_manifest.py:28-30`. Verified as NOT hardcoding the engine dir (untouched): `scripts/check_repo_root_from_package.py`, `scripts/check_repo_root_from_tracker.py`, `scripts/check_tickets_boundary.py`.

**Docs (Approach step 9) line cites:** `docs/user-guide.md:658-661`, `docs/architecture.md:31,72,244-272`, `README.md:289`, `docs/exit-codes.md:55-57`; `docs/code-navigation.md`, `docs/coverage.md`, `docs/config.md`, `docs/reuse-surface.md` (whole-file spelling pass).

**`.github/complexity-baseline.json` (Approach step 10) — the six keys**, re-spelled from `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/...` to `src/rebar/reconciler/...` with ceilings unchanged: `outbound_fields.py::_diff_fields:32`, `applier.py::apply:22`, `binding_walk.py::compute_binding_walk_mutations:27`, `dispatch_one.py::create_one:36`, `inbound_differ.py::_diff_jira_vs_local:16`, `outbound_field_diff.py::diff_canonical_fields:23`. (`.github/mechanism-baseline.json` has 29 `autouse_fixture::tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/...` keys; they are untouched by this story because the test package does not move here — the next story re-spells them.)

**`sys.modules` keys the source registers and tests pre-seed (all deleted by the Approach step 8 codemod):** dotted `rebar_reconciler.{_advisory_lock,mode,request,pass_support,_preflight,alert_store,mutation,config,link_direction,adapters.jira.adf,operation_outcome,failure_policy,git_adapter,observation,create_route,coordinator,ticket_planner,ticket_plan,runtime,retry_budget,reconcile_helpers,rebar_id_audit,persist_phase,pass_io,pass_fuse,manifest_renderer,load_phase,dispatch_one,create_coordinator,create_containment,apply_phase,apply_handlers,applier,_errors,batch_dispatch,binding_store,_ref_lock,_loader,__main__}`; flat keys `reconcile_helpers`, `pass_support`, `reconcile_mutation`, `rebar_reconciler_errors`, `rebar_reconciler__ref_lock_advisory`, `rebar_reconciler_ref_lock_advisory`, `rebar_reconciler_ref_lock_push`, `rebar_reconciler_config`, `rebar_reconciler_alert_store`, `reconcile_selection_binding_store`, `reconcile_run_differs`, `reconcile_config`, `reconcile_classify`, `reconcile_binding_walk`, `_concurrency`, `conflict_resolver`, `config`, `overview`, `rebar._engine_mode`, `rebar_reconciler_classify_fsck`; test-private keys (`applier`, `fetcher`, `reconcile_*`, `rebar_reconciler_advisory_lock`, `rebar_reconciler_mode`, ~60 per-file names). 343 test files / 442 `spec_from_file_location` sites; 149 files `import rebar_reconciler`. `pyproject.toml:691-698` has `testpaths=["tests"]` and no `pythonpath`/`rootdir` — the package rename needs no pytest config change.

**Kept, not deleted (already discharged on origin/main):** `Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK` is absent (`mode.py:39-42`); `_ref_lock.py:717` writer persists `"dry-run"` (`_PAUSE_GATED_MODE`, `:591`) and the decoder keeps `_PAUSE_LEGACY_GATED_MODES={"reconcile-check"}` (`:592`) — bug `extralegal-durative-beaver` is closed (Gerrit 2728); `mode.py:57` `from_str("reconcile-check")→DRY_RUN` and `_ref_lock.py:592` stay as persisted-pause-blob read compat. `MODE_CAPS` is live (`__main__.py:187`, `apply_planning.py:93`, `load_phase.py:165`, `ticket_planner.py:60`) and the bootstrap modes are live consumers (`reconcile-bridge.yml:59-60`, DC harness `tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_mutations.py:70`, `manifest_renderer.py`) — kept; only the MCP by-path load and the dead `ctx.MODE_CAPS`/`ctx.Mode` handles (`mcp_server.py:599-600`, no registrar reads them) are deleted.

**Release note (BREAKING) for `CHANGELOG.md`:** `python -m rebar_reconciler` becomes `python -m rebar.reconciler`; the top-level `rebar_reconciler` import name is removed with no shim (ADR 0083, ADR 0111); `rebar._engine.engine_env` no longer prepends `PYTHONPATH`.
